summary: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. (ATII), a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to a private-placement subscription agreement signed April 20, 2026 with an accredited investor, who committed to buy 10,000,000 Pubco shares concurrently with the closing of the business combination with Forge Nano, Inc. ATII Holdings Inc. (Pubco) and Forge Nano are co-registrants. The filing, made under Rule 425 and Rule 14a-12, indicates solicitation materials. Exact amended pricing was not stated in the excerpt. Watch for closing conditions and any redemption-driven shortfall in PIPE proceeds.
